title: office.attach response
description: What was attached (or, for a dry run, would be), in selection order, and the Library commit every copy was read at.

library_commit.description: The Library repository commit the files were read at; null before its first commit.

artifact_path.description: The task artifact path: context/<library path>.

reason.description: Why it was picked: a template attach policy, a runbook the task names, the task's source, an example in its series, an index search hit, or a page related to another pick.

omitted.description: Candidates not attached: private documents, and those past the limit of 8.

skipped.description: Knowledge page files that could not be read or parsed, so were not considered.

manifest.description: The task artifact recording the task, the Library commit and the attached files; null for a dry run.
